children: Overview
Hong Kong construction equipment provider's interim revenue rose 10.2% yr/yr to HK$58 mln
Company reported a net loss of HK$4.7 mln, compared to a profit last year
Gross profit margin declined to 9.8% due to increased subcontracting fees
Outlook
Company did not provide specific financial guidance for the current quarter or full year
Result Drivers
REVENUE GROWTH - Revenue rose due to increased income from installation, rental and related service of construction equipment
HIGHER SUBCONTRACTING FEES - Gross profit margin fell mainly due to increased subcontracting fees for installation projects
LOWER FINANCE COSTS - Finance costs decreased due to repayment of finance lease liabilities and borrowings
